title: Consolidated taxable income — Granite Group
instructions: Granite Corp. owns 100% of Sub A and Sub B; they file a consolidated return for 2025. Compute consolidated taxable income.

exhibits.title: Separate taxable incomes (before consolidation adjustments)
exhibits.content:
- Granite: **$800,000**, including a **$100,000** dividend from Sub A
- Sub A: **$300,000**, including a **$50,000** gain on land sold to Granite (Granite still holds the land)
- Sub B: **$(200,000)** operating loss

Sub A's income after deferring the intercompany gain
